findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Code injection via eval/exec
 * @description Using eval or exec with untrusted input can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/code-injection-simple
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("exec").getACall()
select call, "Call to eval or exec."
findings.hypothesis: Pygments might use eval or exec to process user input or configuration.
Path traversal via file opening with user-controlled input
